timer: count up while V8=0; stop on V8=1; retain per-device cycles
limitations: Only transitions observed during owner-driven polling can be recorded.
Cycle endpoints are Blynk fetch observation times; exact hardware transition and measurement times are unknown.
Interrupted ON spans may contain unobserved state changes and are marked.
All cycles are retained in the database; API responses include the latest 50. The compact card displays the active or most recent cycle.
overview_display: Compact V8 card with elapsed clock, ON/OFF status and ON-observation time; detailed timer panel removed.
